items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen2.5-VL vision-language models
items.summary: Qwen2.5-VL is an open-weight vision-language family (3B, 7B, 72B) with object grounding, document parsing, hour-long video understanding and computer/phone agent abilities. Qwen reports the 72B model is competitive with leading models, especially on document and diagram understanding.
